snapshots.character: Precision guidance and manufacturing ecosystem; Deere is still mostly a machine company, but GPS/positioning is becoming strategic.
snapshots.interpretation: The ecosystem is narrow and technology-supplier/OEM-heavy. The orchestration problem is technical integration, not yet data-platform governance.

snapshots.character: Telematics/precision-ag maturation; guidance, rate control and equipment data are becoming differentiators.
snapshots.interpretation: Deere is building the substrate for a future platform but much remains hardware-centric.

snapshots.character: Operations Center/API platform and AI/autonomy acquisitions; Leap Ambitions era.
snapshots.interpretation: The case inflection point: Deere wants to orchestrate an ecosystem, but customer trust, right-to-repair, data rights and affordability are constraints.

snapshots.character: AI-enabled production-system ecosystem; Deere complements platform openness with selective acquisition of critical sensing/autonomy assets.
snapshots.interpretation: Deere’s ecosystem is denser and more ambidextrous: open APIs where adoption needs interoperability, but acquisitions where critical data/model/control loops are strategic.

source_line: Source: public announcements compiled by C. Gartenberg (Deere alliances workbook, 2026).
notes: Start = first announcement year, else the first snapshot (2000/2010/2022/2026) listing it. Rows her 2026 slide omits (Trimble, FarmLogs/Bushel, Raven) are left out.
